text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Tiara Umamusume grit their teeth and keep 
running, even when they're losing...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Every single side of her like that was 
shining so brightly.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So... I want to run just like the people 
I've always looked up to!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Just shining isn't enough. Today, I 
will win!
